rule.description: A public named item of the rui library (function, method, struct, enum, const, static, or type alias) is unused public scaffolding when its simple name never occurs in executable code outside the scaffold region that defines it, in any crate of the workspace. Module declarations and use/re-export plumbing do not count as uses, and occurrences inside the extent of another unused item confer no liveness.

checks.description: A publicly visible named item of the rui library has no live caller anywhere in the workspace: its simple name is mentioned only by module plumbing (mod declarations, use/re-export statements), by the item's own definition, or by code inside the extent of another equally unused item.
checks.detected_relation: public API item -> zero live users in any workspace crate, with its only nominal visibility coming from re-export plumbing
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Dead public scaffolding enlarges the API surface and must be read, understood, and kept compiling through later refactors although no code path can ever reach it; the re-export plumbing makes it look fully wired up, so lack of a caller is invisible to the standard toolchain.

matches.evidence: Public enum re-exported at the crate root through `pub use inspector::*;`, but no executable code outside the inspector scaffold names this type; its only mentions are its own variants and neighbors inside the same unused extent.
Public method on OverlayStyle whose only call site is InspectorView::draw, itself an unused scaffold item; outside that extent the name never occurs in any workspace crate.
Public method on OverlayStyle referenced only from InspectorView::draw, which is part of the same dead scaffold; no live code path passes through it.
Public wrapper view type reachable from the crate root via glob re-export, yet no example or library code ever constructs it except through the equally unused `inspector` free function.
Public constructor method on InspectorView called only by the sibling free function `inspector`, which is itself reported; the extent hosting the call is dead.
Public free function that is the only nominal entry point of the inspector feature; apart from re-export plumbing no executable statement in the workspace invokes it.
Trait method added to the public Modifiers chain; it forwards to the dead `inspector` function and nothing in the crate or its examples chains `.debug_overlay(...)` onto any view.
Public diagnostics accessor on Context whose only call site is the dead InspectorView::draw; no live drawing or layout code asks Context for all layout rectangles.
Public diagnostics accessor on Context read only by the inspector's Command branch, which belongs to the unused scaffold; the existing dirty-region machinery keeps its own internal uses.
Public Paint constructor added alongside the existing color helpers; the only caller is the dead OverlayStyle::overlay_paint, so no live view ever obtains a paint through it.
Public command-name constant registered only by InspectorView::commands and decoded only by InspectorView::process, both inside the dead scaffold; no menu binding elsewhere refers to it.

excluded.reason: Latent unused public item already present at the pinned baseline commit; not introduced by this case and excluded so the rule fires only on scaffolding added on top of the recorded baseline.
